heading_path: Part 17A—Protected international trade marks under the Madrid Protocol
17A.12  Registrar to examine, and report on, IRDA
text: If the Registrar receives from the International Bureau a notification of an IRDA, the Registrar must examine and report on: (a) whether the IRDA is in accordance with this Division; and (b) whether there are grounds under Subdivision 2 for rejecting it.
title: Registrar to examine, and report on, IRDA

units.text: If the Registrar receives from the International Bureau a notification of an IRDA, the Registrar must examine and report on:
(a) whether the IRDA is in accordance with this Division; and
(b) whether there are grounds under Subdivision 2 for rejecting it.
